summary.intent: Complete Phase 45 (Desktop FUSE write-durability cleanup) through the full GSD workflow: plan → execute → verify → code review → security audit → Nyquist validation → PR → simplify → resolve PR review comments. The phase was a Rust-only refactor of the FUSE write-journal/replay code with 7 scope items and a strict no-behavior-change contract.
summary.outcome: All 7 scope items implemented across 6 plans in 5 waves, 266 tests passing, all GSD gates passed (verification 7/7, security 18/18 threats closed, Nyquist compliant 0 gaps). PR #491 opened, pushed, and updated with a security fix (file key zeroization) and two deferred findings logged as todos. Two false-positive blockers from deep code review were proven false by diffing pre/post implementation.

repo: cipherbox-fuse is the Rust crate name (default feature `fuse`); `cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse` and `--workspace` both work
winfsp path cannot compile on macOS due to Windows-only deps (windows_core, winfsp-sys); it is CI-gated on Windows runners, not locally testable

`publish_file_metadata` pre-existed before Phase 45 with identical conflict-swallowing behavior (`Conflict { .. } => warn + record_publish + Ok`) and was already called by the live release path — deep reviewer conflated it with folder/bin publish's retry-and-retain path
`cipherbox_crypto::wrap_key` is literally `pub use ecies::wrap_key` — safe to treat as canonical across all call sites
`generate_file_key()` returns a plain `[u8; 32]` with no zeroize-on-drop — callers must explicitly clear it on every exit path

`resolve_sequence` in PublishCoordinator falls back to cache on failure (`Err => Ok(cached)`), so a transient IPNS failure with a cached seq returns Found(cached) rather than routing through IpnsResolveOutcome::Error
`gh pr edit` exits 1 on this repo because it queries deprecated Projects-classic; workaround is `gh api -X PATCH repos/$OWNER/$REPO/pulls/$N -F body=@file`
Bare `#NN` in GitHub PR body auto-links to issue/PR references in GFM; use backticks (`` `[#11]` ``) to render literally when there are no corresponding issues
`cargo fmt` on the fuse crate is whole-crate scoped — formatting a new module (journal_helpers.rs) reformats all other files in the crate, dirtying out-of-scope files

code.finding: New file created in Phase 45 consolidating fuser/winfsp journal builders. After /simplify pass: extracted current_unix_ms(), generate_entry_id(), wrap_key_to_hex() helpers to remove copy-paste; dropped dead wrapped_key_hex rename-clone; collapsed duplicate inode lookups; fixed contradictory doc comment about plaintext field

resolve_ipns_for_replay: cache-fallback in resolve_sequence causes transient IPNS failures to return Found(cached) instead of IpnsResolveOutcome::Error, so replay continues (publishes at cached+1) instead of retaining the journal entry — pre-existing behavior, deferred as todo
Empty file_meta_ipns_name in legacy journal entries publishes an empty-locator FilePointer — explicitly preserved as pre-Phase-45 behavior by Phase 45 #18, deferred as heavy-lift todo

workflow: gsd_run query commit can return a false-negative commit_failed even when the commit succeeded (lint-staged output in error body); always verify with git log rather than trusting the return value
Deep code review on a no-behavior-change refactor phase frequently produces false-positive 'blockers' — verify by diffing the specific pre/post code paths the reviewer cites, not just running tests
Stale rust-analyzer diagnostics (E0308 in IDE) do not reflect the actual committed build state; `cargo check --workspace` exit code is the authoritative check
After parallel wave execution, check `git diff` for out-of-scope cargo fmt drift before any completion commits — discard with `git checkout -- crates/` if all changes are whitespace-only
When a PR body needs to reference internal item IDs that look like issue numbers (#NN), pre-escape them as backtick-wrapped literals before creating the PR
The /simplify pass correctly finds cleanup in new files introduced by the phase; run it after execute+verify but before the PR to keep the diff clean
For zeroize safety in Rust: any function returning a plain byte array (no Zeroize impl) requires explicit clear on every early-return path, not just the happy path

friction: gsd_run query commit returned false-negative `commit_failed` for a commit that actually succeeded — required git log verification before proceeding
GitHub push timed out transiently on first attempt with connection refused to github.com:443; succeeded immediately on retry with no changes needed
Stale rust-analyzer diagnostics (E0308, 'not in module tree') appeared as real errors three separate times across different plans, each requiring `cargo check --workspace` to confirm they were false
Deep code reviewer raised 2 false-positive blockers (CR-01 conflict handling, CR-02 write_generation) requiring manual pre/post diff investigation before the review could be finalized

Stray whole-crate `cargo fmt` from 45-06 executor left 14 out-of-scope files dirty, requiring diagnosis (`git diff -w` to confirm formatting-only) and `git checkout -- crates/` discard before final state verification
`gh pr edit` exits 1 on this repo due to Projects-classic deprecation, requiring REST API workaround (`gh api -X PATCH`) to update the PR body
open_items: [fuse/replay] resolve_ipns_for_replay strict resolve path: add a cache-bypassing PublishCoordinator method so only a real resolve success becomes Found(cached); currently a transient IPNS failure with cached seq causes replay to continue instead of retaining the entry. Logged as todo at .planning/todos/pending/2026-06-15-replay-resolve-ipns-strict-resolve-path-no-cache-fallback.md (CodeRabbit Thread 3, crates/fuse/src/lib.rs ~L217-222)

Heavy lift; requires new replay pre-check. Logged as todo at .planning/todos/pending/2026-06-15-replay-empty-file-meta-ipns-name-publishes-empty-filepointer.md (CodeRabbit Thread 4)

CI results for PR #491 (PR-title check, build/test, signature verification) were pending at session close — worth checking after CI completes
